sloka: सा प्रमथ्य रथं तस्य निपपात शिला भुवि ।सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं सध्वजं सशरासनम् ।। ६.५२.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: sā pramathya rathaṁ tasya nipapāta śilā bhuvi ।sacakrakūbaraṁ sāśvaṁ sadhvajaṁ saśarāsanam ।। 6.52.29 ।।।।

translations.english: That rock fell on the chariot and got crushed along with its wheel and axle and with arrows.
